{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders found in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Drop QA orders if any
if len(qa_orders) > 0:
    completed_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Now compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = completed_orders.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

# Print the results
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Identify the channel with highest revenue
best_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
print(f'Channel with highest total revenue: {best_channel}')"}
